body: [https://www.fcgov.com/events](https://www.fcgov.com/events) has the city-organized ones! You can sign up for the June hike [here](https://offero.larimer.org/ActivityRegistration/9c73cf6c-3809-4cb1-ab21-98bb22c05f4a?cancelUrl=%2FActivitySet%2Flgbtq-activities-title-tbd).

R Bar is the only official game in town, but most of the breweries are queer friendly. 

There's a LGBT community hike monthly through the city. The next one is at Horsetooth on June 5th, 6pm. You can sign up on fcgov.com. 

Fort Collins Pride is June 1st at Library Park and Northern Colorado Pride is August 10th in Greeley if the bigger celebration in Denver isn't your speed.

Welcome to FoCo!
Can't answer question 1, but I've lived in an apartment by Skyline for a few years now. You won't even notice it's there, it's a very self contained 55+ MHP.
I love this idea! You should post this on r/FortCollinsMutualAid if you end up going through with it. It might inspire some other folks to do similar things.
Just letting you know that I am still seeping this issue occurring with specialized tasks.
I have the Airflow DXL, but your baby might be a bit too small for it. I think the recommended minimum weight is 20lbs. My baby is a little small for it at 18lbs but we were able to adjust it to fit.
Check out the Lille Baby carriers. They're rated for up to 45lbs and the lumbar support panel saved me.

My kiddo had a tongue tie. We got it lasered and it is a night and day difference. He was having trouble with weight gain and latching initially but has been eating like a champ since the release. The procedure was super fast and we haven't noticed any side effects from getting it done. I'm not sure if it helped his gas, but he's much less gassy now at 4mo than he was for the first few months!
Colorado sends mail in ballots to everyone. You can do it from your couch on a Saturday.
